need.title: HOA election notice is out
need.body: Nomination notice mailed Aug 31. Deadline was Sep 21. Second notice with ballot and proposed budget goes out next; vote electronically on Get Quorum or drop a physical ballot. Ballots due by the Annual Meeting Nov 4.

need.title: LSV golf carts — county road rules
need.body: Sarasota County: LSVs only on roads posted 35 mph or less. Licensed/registered carts may use E Manasota Beach Rd to cross 776. Register every BeachWalk cart with the HOA before use.
